name: Gate TMA tile construction on operand alignment
summary: Use TMA tile movement only when A and B element types and declared alignments satisfy the Hopper TMA byte-alignment requirement.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Apply a compile-time alignment predicate before selecting a TMA GMMA collective.

tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.
